name: ĐT (Investor) Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Investment capital under VND 3 billion in a Vietnamese enterprise. Visa valid up to 1 year.

requirement_groups.name: ĐT3 -- VND 3 billion to under 50 billion

requirements.blocker_text: Investment capital from VND 3 billion to under 50 billion. Visa and temporary residence card valid up to 3 years.

requirement_groups.name: ĐT2 -- VND 50 billion to under 100 billion

requirements.blocker_text: Investment capital from VND 50 billion to under 100 billion. Visa and temporary residence card valid up to 5 years.

requirement_groups.name: ĐT1 -- VND 100 billion or more (or preferred-sector investment)

requirements.blocker_text: Investment capital of VND 100 billion or more, OR investment in a sector/location the State prioritizes for development. Visa valid up to 5 years; temporary residence card valid up to 10 years.

evidence_required.document: Investment registration certificate / enterprise registration certificate showing capital contribution
Proof of lawful origin of investment funds

outcome.duration_length: 1 to 5 years by tier (visa); temporary residence card 1 to 10 years by tier

sources.title: LuatVietnam (private legal database) -- consolidated Law on Entry, Exit, Transit and Residence of Foreigners: DT1-DT4 investor visa tiers by VND capital threshold, Article 9

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Vietnam). STATUS: DRAFT, TIER-3 ONLY -- the four-tier capital-threshold structure comes from a private legal database's reproduction of the consolidated law text, not an independently fetched .gov.vn source; the specific VND figures were not cross-checked against a second source. leads_to_pr is true for all tiers but pr_after_months is left null since Vietnam's actual thẻ thường trú (permanent residence) eligibility, per vn_permanent_residence.json, is NOT a general years-of-residence pathway open to any investor -- it is limited to a narrow set of categories (meritorious foreigners, scientists/experts, family of Vietnamese permanent residents, certain stateless persons); an ĐT investor is not automatically in a qualifying category, disclosed here rather than assumed. Under Law 118/2025/QH15 (effective 1 July 2026, confirmed via the Ministry of Public Security's own site, tier-1), a new UĐ1 preferential visa exists for 'high-quality digital industry talent' with LS/DT1/DT2/UĐ1/UĐ2 visas capped at 5 years and DT1/UĐ1/UĐ2 residence cards extended to 10 years -- this mainly confirms DT1's existing terms rather than changing them, and UĐ1 is modeled as a separate concept (skilled-talent, not capital-investment) not included in this file.
